title: All-root recursive closure is not established by the pinned proof
note: The pinned arithmetic faithfully instantiates the published bound, and production code enforces recursive parent, height, and genesis constraints. The unresolved step is the ideal-compiler lemma that must prove statement-exclusive database flips and representation of every extracted nested artifact in the same measured database. The cited fixed-instance and adaptive results do not directly supply that unbounded recursive closure. No concrete counterexample was found, so the finding is inconclusive.
